There must be no leaves or stems starting at the top and hanging down. Shape is a broad, slightly horizontal spreading fan of compound leaves with clearly separated elongated oval leaflets in paired rows. Stylized anime game painted foliage, calm graphic leaf shapes, softly graded saturated warm olive green to yellow-green, at most two closely related color families. Match the elegant painted broad strokes of a stylized game, neither photorealism nor icon outlines. Medium-sized readable paired leaflets, not tiny noisy speckles. Many clean transparent gaps between leaflets and compound fronds, moderate coverage around 40%, natural irregular edge. Each of four variations has an asymmetrical fan of 3 to 5 short compound fronds, maybe 30 to 45 oval leaflets, quiet continuous color gradients. Very faint thin olive stems, leaves visually dominant. No veins, no bark, no cast shadows, no bloom, no white fringe, no lettering, no surrounding tree, no texture grain, no extra backdrop. Four similar but distinct upward rooted fans, each entirely in its quadrant. The whole image is the texture atlas alone.
